why: Когда мы пересказываем чужой вопрос, просьбу или приказ, мы не цитируем их дословно, а встраиваем в свою фразу. В русском это просто: «Он спросил, где я живу». В английском есть ловушка: после reported question порядок слов становится как в утверждении, без do/does/did.
formation: 1) Вопросы с вопросительным словом (what, where, when, why, how):
asked / wanted to know + вопросительное слово + подлежащее + глагол (порядок как в утверждении).
"Where do you work?" → He asked where I worked.
2) Вопросы без вопросительного слова (да/нет): if или whether.
"Do you like coffee?" → She asked if I liked coffee.
3) Времена сдвигаются назад, как в теме 25: do → did, am/is → was, will → would, can → could, have done → had done.
4) Просьбы и приказы: told / asked / ordered + кого + (not) to + глагол.
"Open the file." → He told me to open the file.
"Please don't be late." → She asked me not to be late.
Вопросительный знак в косвенном вопросе не ставится.
usage: 1. Пересказ вопроса: She asked me what time the meeting started. (Она спросила меня, во сколько начинается встреча.)
2. Пересказ вопроса да/нет: I asked him whether he had finished the task. (Я спросил его, закончил ли он задачу.)
3. Пересказ просьбы: The client asked us to send the invoice. (Клиент попросил нас отправить счёт.)
4. Пересказ приказа или запрета: The manager told him not to deploy on Friday. (Менеджер велел ему не деплоить в пятницу.)
signalWords: asked, wanted to know, wondered, told someone to, asked someone to, if, whether.
Местоимения и слова времени тоже меняются: I → he/she, my → his/her, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there.
mistakes: ✗ He asked where did I live. → ✓ He asked where I lived. (после asked порядок слов прямой, do/did не нужен)
✗ She asked me do I like tea. → ✓ She asked me if I liked tea. (в вопросе да/нет нужен if или whether)
✗ He told me open the door. → ✓ He told me to open the door. (после told/asked + кого нужен to)
✗ She asked me to not go. → ✓ She asked me not to go. (not стоит перед to + глагол)
✗ He said me to wait. → ✓ He told me to wait. (say не берёт «кому» напрямую, нужен tell)
remember: Косвенный вопрос = не вопрос: порядок слов как в утверждении, без do/did, без знака вопроса; да/нет-вопрос открывай через if.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте пропущенное слово (if / where / what / to / not to)

items.prompt: "Do you speak French?" → She asked me ___ I spoke French.
items.answer: if / whether

items.prompt: "Where do you live?" → He asked me ___ I lived.
items.answer: where

items.prompt: "Close the window." → She told me ___ close the window.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: "Don't touch it." → He told me ___ ___ touch it.
items.answer: not to

items.prompt: "What is your name?" → She asked me ___ my name was.
items.answer: what

items.prompt: "Is the server down?" → He wanted to know ___ the server was down.
items.answer: if / whether

items.prompt: "Please help me." → She asked him ___ help her.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: "Why are you late?" → The boss asked me ___ I was late.
items.answer: why

items.prompt: He asked me (a) where did I work (b) where I worked.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: She asked (a) if I was tired (b) was I tired.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: The teacher told us (a) to open (b) open our books.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: He asked her (a) not to be (b) to not be late.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: I asked him (a) what he was doing (b) what was he doing.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: She (a) said (b) told me to wait here.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: They wanted to know (a) when would the train arrive (b) when the train would arrive.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: He asked me (a) whether I had seen the report (b) whether had I seen the report.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: "Where do you work?" He asked me ...
items.answer: He asked me where I worked.

items.prompt: "Are you ready?" She asked me ...
items.answer: She asked me if I was ready. / She asked me whether I was ready.

items.prompt: "Send me the file." My boss told me ...
items.answer: My boss told me to send him the file. / My boss told me to send her the file.

items.prompt: "Don't be late." She told us ...
items.answer: She told us not to be late.

items.prompt: "What time does the meeting start?" He wanted to know ...
items.answer: He wanted to know what time the meeting started.

items.prompt: "Can you fix the bug?" The client asked me ...
items.answer: The client asked me if I could fix the bug. / The client asked me whether I could fix the bug.

items.prompt: "Have you finished the task?" She asked him ...
items.answer: She asked him if he had finished the task. / She asked him whether he had finished the task.

items.prompt: "Please turn off your phone." The guard asked me ...
items.answer: The guard asked me to turn off my phone.

items.prompt: He asked me where did I live.
items.answer: He asked me where I lived.

items.prompt: She asked me do I like pizza.
items.answer: She asked me if I liked pizza.

items.prompt: The manager told me send the report.
items.answer: The manager told me to send the report.

items.prompt: He said me to wait outside.
items.answer: He told me to wait outside.

items.prompt: She asked me to not make noise.
items.answer: She asked me not to make noise.

items.prompt: They asked what time is it.
items.answer: They asked what time it was.

items.prompt: He asked me that I had a car.
items.answer: He asked me if I had a car. / He asked me whether I had a car.

items.prompt: I asked her where was the station?
items.answer: I asked her where the station was.

items.prompt: Он спросил меня, где я работаю.
items.answer: He asked me where I worked.

items.prompt: Она спросила, есть ли у меня время.
items.answer: She asked if I had time. / She asked whether I had time.

items.prompt: Менеджер попросил меня отправить ему отчёт.
items.answer: The manager asked me to send him the report.

items.prompt: Врач сказал мне не пить кофе вечером.
items.answer: The doctor told me not to drink coffee in the evening.

items.prompt: Клиент спросил, когда мы закончим сайт.
items.answer: The client asked when we would finish the website.

items.prompt: Я спросил коллегу, понимает ли он этот код.
items.answer: I asked my colleague if he understood this code. / I asked my colleague whether he understood this code.

items.prompt: Таксист спросил, куда мы едем.
items.answer: The taxi driver asked where we were going.

items.prompt: Мама сказала мне позвонить ей вечером.
items.answer: My mom told me to call her in the evening.
